lead_headline: Restaurant tracker adds six leads overnight — Snarf's Hampden opening plus El Pollo Loco Lakewood launch lead the batch as active total climbs to 178

restaurant.blurb: Six new leads today — Snarf's Hampden (opened yesterday), El Pollo Loco Lakewood, Denver Café & Kava Park Hill, Port of Subs Littleton, Spicy Kitchen Westminster (truck-to-brick pivot), Tacos el Comando Aurora. Active tracker: 178 (101 openings, 77 closures).

liquor.blurb: Twenty days in the void — Colorado's liquor license portal remains completely dead since April 30's renewal flurry with zero applications, zero status changes, zero activity across all license classes statewide. The paralysis now stretches across the entire May reporting window with no official explanation, no recovery timeline, no acknowledgment from state regulators as the industry remains locked out. Total tracked frozen at 12,396 licenses.

reputation.blurb: Seven mentions yesterday — drive-thru coffee saturation debate, Nativ Hotel fraud coverage, Root Down chapter transition lead Monday's haul — lifts 7-day total to 48 across 12 sources, down 4% from prior week's 50. Instagram commands 27% share (13 mentions), Facebook 23% (11), Denver Post 17% (8). Google News RSS accounts for 92% of discoveries (44 of 48). Monthly total sits at 208 as the week-over-week pace stabilizes after prior period's sharp drop.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) extends the weekend drought to three consecutive zero days — MTD holds at +21 (+1.1/day), 90-day net sits at +134. The recent pattern shows stark bifurcation: mid-week delivered strong gains (+9 across May 12-15), but acquisition has completely vanished over the past 72 hours with zero activity. The 7-day window closes at +5 (10 new, 5 canceled), up slightly from prior period's +4 despite the weekend blackout that's now erased all momentum heading into midweek.
